summary.background: It was confirmed that we can get the degree of compaction needed for reasonable compaction of dam body by calculating the field dry density from inverse operation of the standard void ratio.
summary.method: The standard void ratio of CFRD that can be easily used by dam designers and field engineers was proposed from the monitoring data.
